details: The package installs a console command named python2 (pyyi.cli:main), so it runs when someone types python2. _register() in cli.py POSTs the hostname and OS to a space-z.ai server and keeps the returned apiKey in ~/.python2/config.json. Bare python2 is a real REPL that reads input with the echo off and sends typed words to the server's unlock endpoint. Other commands download gzip and base64 code from /api/cli/payload and run it with exec in memory, hiding failures behind Python's can't open file error. Comments in the file call this the cover. I did not see what the served code does. I read 2.4 and 2.4.1, which differ only in the version string, and did not run them.
